dct_description_sm: The purpose of this research is to document the lived experiences and support needs of long-serving community-based mental health and addiction workers in a region of Canada undergoing significant social and economic change (the Northwest Territories).  The two main research questions guiding this inquiry are: (1) How do long-serving community mental health and addictions workers experience and respond to rapid socio-economic change in relation to their professional practice? (2) What are the support needs of these practitioners in light of continued change in the region?
